ValidationRule.description: This validation rule allows only system admin, sales admin and users with Channel Program Manager role to update Partner Account Status to Registered.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(ISPICKVAL( Type, "Partner" ), NOT(OR( $Profile.Name = 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name = 'Sales Administrator', $UserRole.Name = 'Channel Program Manager') ), ISPICKVAL(NSP_Status__c, 'Registered'), ISCHANGED(NSP_Status__c),$Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.AccountValidations__c != true)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Only Channel Program Managers can mark Partner Accounts as Registered.
